maya (prod-eng): Quick check — final cut deadline for v3.2 is this Friday 11:59pm PT. Can everyone confirm if they can make the go/no-go on Saturday @ 10:00am PT?
ryan (pm): I can make the 10am. I'll bring the rollout plan and risk summary.
sophia (eng-qa): 10am works for QA. Will have the smoke test matrix and top 5 regression runs ready.
omar (oncall): Oncall can join but prefer we keep it <45m. Need the cutoff list for what to block on.
maya (prod-eng): Agreed — propose agenda: 1) Quick status (5m) 2) Blockers + cut decisions (15m) 3) Rollout plan + canary criteria (10m) 4) Rollback & postmortem owners (10m) 5) Final vote (5m).
ryan (pm): That looks good. Can we add a pre-check item: confirm infra capacity and DB migrations are staged?
sophia (eng-qa): Adding pre-checks: DB migration dry-run ✅, smoke tests on staging ✅, load test sample ✅. If anything regresses we should trigger a hold.
maya (prod-eng): Perfect. I'll send calendar invite with dial-in and a short readout doc. RSVP requested by Friday 6pm PT. If you can't attend, ping +1 with a delegate.
omar (oncall): Quick note on rollback: we need a documented fast-path to disable feature flags and an ops playbook for hotfix deploys. I'll paste the snippet here.
omar (oncall): ```rollback checklist
- disable feature flag: ffctl set v3_feature false
- redeploy stable tag: deployctl promote stable
- verify health: /_status (200) and p95 latency < 500ms
- notify #incidents and stakeholder pager
```
ryan (pm): Nice. We'll put owners next to each item in the invite. Maya — can you include the stakeholder matrix (who must vote yes) and the cut criteria?
maya (prod-eng): Yes. Cut criteria draft: no Sev1s, all critical regressions fixed or mitigated, DB migration dry-run success, canary alpha at 0.5% for 30m with no errors >1% rate. If any fail, we hold.
sophia (eng-qa): I'll attach the smoke test links in the doc. Also tagging @ryan to confirm the marketing freeze window.
ryan (pm): Marketing freeze is 24h before deploy. We're good for Saturday.
maya (prod-eng): Thanks all. If you can't make it, drop your vote in the thread with a +1 / -1 and reason by Friday 6pm PT. deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2025-09-12 10:00-11:00 UTC (metadata: release v3.2). :calendar: 
ryan (pm): one last ask — please add any last-minute runbook edits by EOD Thurs so ops has time to review. :thumbsup:
